field_corrections.problem: 'No application code updates or deletes a ledger row' leaves out that both ledger repositories carry the means: WalletTransactionRepository::update() and ::delete(array $params) (the delete is the assessor's own evidence line) and LoyaltyPointTransactionRepository::update() and ::delete(array $params) exist on main. Nothing calls them (grep of walletTransactionRepo and loyaltyPointTransactionRepo finds no ->update or ->delete call), but a source-scan test would flag them.
field_corrections.replacement: No application code calls an update or a delete on a ledger row (the six writers insert; customer statements and admin reports read). The means are there, unused: WalletTransactionRepository and LoyaltyPointTransactionRepository each carry update() and delete(array $params) on main, and nothing calls them. User has no SoftDeletes; REST v1 and web account_delete call $user->delete() after checking ongoing orders and the Auction guard, with no wallet or points check. wallet_transactions.user_id has no foreign key, so rows stay as orphans. No test pins either fact.

field_corrections.problem: The planned source-scan test 'nothing updates or deletes ledger rows' cannot pass while the unused update() and delete() of the two ledger repositories exist.

field_corrections.problem: 'PR 15 pins LF-1 to LF-7 and LO-04' overclaims. PR 15's own tests pin LF-1 and LF-2 (PointsToWalletFormulaCharacterizationTest) and LF-6; LF-7 only indirectly (its proposals document says so); LF-3 'Not pinned in this change' and LF-4 'Not pinned separately'. LO-04 and LF-5 are pinned by PR 10's LoyaltyPointCharacterizationTest, which PR 15 carries as its base.
field_corrections.replacement: PR 10: both points writers locked; points-to-wallet is one transaction (PointsToWalletConversion): a refused points debit rolls back the wallet credit; concurrency and characterization tests, which also pin LO-04 (a refund can take points below zero) and LF-5 (CustomerManager writes a zero-point row) as current behaviour. PR 15 (stacked on PR 10): pins LF-1 and LF-2 (REST and web credit different amounts for the same points) and LF-6 (the delivery credit is recomputed, not the recorded line points) by test, and LF-7 only indirectly through the refund test; LF-3 (the web preview formula) and LF-4 (the earn rounding helpers) are written up in docs/wallet/refund-loyalty-idempotency-proposals.md and pinned by no test. It proposes one helper; nothing changes.

field_corrections.problem: 'immutable rows' is not true: VendorLedger::releaseMatured (line 217), SettlementEngine (stamps settlement_id, sets status paid) and PayoutService (lines 227, 281, 373) update status and settlement_id of ledger entries in place; only the amounts are append-only. The currency column is the store's default currency (VendorLedger::baseCurrency) unless a caller passes one, not an order's currency.
field_corrections.replacement: Marketplace code on main has a seller ledger (a currency column stamped with the store's default currency unless a caller passes one, append-only amounts, idempotent record, row lock; the status and settlement_id of an entry are updated in place by VendorLedger::releaseMatured, SettlementEngine and PayoutService, so entries are not immutable), a SettlementEngine (nets all available entries, copies the currency of the first) and payouts, but their tables are in no migration or tracked dump and no test reads them. seller_wallets, admin_wallets, order_transactions and withdraw_requests have no currency; the admin wallet is one row (admin_id = 1). No legal-entity key; Odoo reconciliations are per company and currency (H2).

missing_requirements.requirement: Wallet top-up (add fund) by gateway and by admin, the 'add' sites of the plan line 368 review: one credit per payment (replay-safe at wallet level), the payment named on the ledger row, the add-fund bonus applied once, a conversion that credits what was paid, and the credit going to the wallet of the market where it was made
missing_requirements.evidence_note: No requirement has the top-up as its subject; only fragments sit in E-01 AC3 and E-05 AC4, and the two units point at each other (unit D2's cross note for plan 359-370 hands the gateway top-up hook to E, E's cross note for plan 291-311 hands the replay guard to D2). On main, add_fund_to_wallet_success (app/Utils/module-helper.php lines 298-311) converts payment to USD, then usdToDefaultCurrency (which floors), then CustomerManager::create_wallet_transaction(payer_id, amount, 'add_fund', 'add_funds_to_wallet', payment_data) converts back with Convert::usd; the ledger reference is the literal 'add_funds_to_wallet', no payment id, no idempotency key. PaymentSettlementService (MyFatoorah, line 497) refuses to retry a top-up hook unattended because the credit has no reference to check; PaymeraController (lines 296-304) and MtnCashPaymentController (lines 882-912) claim is_paid before the hook, other gateways do not. Admin top-up CustomerWalletController::addFund passes no actor. Draft code that exists: the sale gate on customer_add_to_fund_request (PR 42, PR 83 tree, asserted by StorefrontSalesRoutesTest) and lavkooapp#5 refusing a top-up on a browse-only storefront. So some code exists and the wallet-level once-per-payment key, payment reference, bonus rule and conversion rule are MISSING.
